title: MisconceptionEntry
description: Schema for entries in the Misconception Taxonomy DB. Used by the Misconception Diagnosis Agent (Generate-Retrieve-Rerank pipeline) and the Assignment Design Agent (misconception-aware distractor generation).

knowledge_component.description: Primary KC this misconception is associated with

related_knowledge_components.description: Additional KCs affected by this misconception

label.description: Short, human-readable label for the misconception

description.description: Detailed description of the flawed mental model

common_trigger.description: Problem type or context that commonly triggers this misconception

example_student_error.description: A concrete example of a student response exhibiting this misconception

example_correct_response.description: The correct response for the same problem

remediation_strategy.description: Recommended pedagogical approach to address this misconception

remediation_hints.description: Pre-authored hint ladder entries tailored to this misconception

severity.description: How critical this misconception is to the learning progression

frequency_percentile.description: How commonly this misconception occurs across the student population (higher = more common)

embedding_vector.description: Dense vector embedding for semantic retrieval (populated at index time)
